Hanno Festival is scheduled for November 7–8, 2026 (Reiwa 8) (Saturday and Sunday). The Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association is now accepting sponsorship donations. New sponsorship levels have been set to make it easy for individuals to participate. You can sponsor by bank transfer (details in the sponsorship guide) or by submitting an application form (PDF or Google Form). For full details, see the sponsorship guide.

More information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e4%bb%a4%e5%92%8c8%e5%b9%b4%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%81%be%e3%81%a4%e3%82%8a%e3%80%80%e5%8d%94%e8%b3%9b%e3%81%ae%e3%81%8a%e9%a1%98%e3%81%84
